address.description: Unique numeric unicast IPv4/IPv6 without scope ID; enforced by preparer

domain.description: ASCII DNS name with labels1..63 and total1..253 bytes, optional final dot; explicit * requires subdomains=true

$comment: The preparer additionally rejects duplicate fields/names/resolvers, malformed UTF-8, invalid labels, symlink/FIFO/special input and more than1MiB. Names are lowercased and the optional final dot removed. A name matches its domain exactly, or its strict dot-boundary descendants when enabled.
